join_log.join: Bike lanes matched to street sections
join_log.method: a bike lane line within 25 m of the section, with the same street name
join_log.notes: Off-road cycling features (Multi-Use Trail*, Park Road) were excluded before matching: they do not occupy a parking lane. A cycling line can match several sections. Source is the Cycling Network record (updated twice a year); the frozen Bikeways record carries an older, different feature set and was not used.

join_log.join: Permit parking areas matched to street sections
join_log.method: the section's midpoint falls inside a permit-area shape
join_log.notes: 97 permit-area shapes; a section is in an area when its midpoint falls inside.

join_log.join: Parking rules matched to street sections
join_log.method: street-name equality, with names tidied into one form (the rules carry no map coordinates for their stretch; 30.5k of 77,940 by-law records point to an intersection at best)
join_log.notes: Counts attach at street level: every section of a street carries the street's rule counts. Rule extents (side, between) stay in bylaw_rules.csv.

join_log.join: Parking tickets 2023-2025 matched to street sections
join_log.method: street name from the ticket's location (house number stripped, first street of intersections), tidied into one form, matched to the street map's street name
join_log.notes: Ticket counts attach at street level. Source files are the sister project's raw ticket files (6,454,695 rows of which 6,454,694 carry a valid date), not re-downloaded.

join_log.join: Parking occupancy matched to Green P car parks
join_log.method: car park number equality: Green P id '52' <-> occupancy 'CP52'; latest year/quarter kept
join_log.notes: Green P snapshot is from 2019; occupancy runs to the latest published quarter. Capacity in the two files can differ; both are kept.
